selected_skill.purpose: Review a foreclosure-auction notice, reconcile current service facts against stale exports, compute buyer cash out, and produce a committee-ready bid memo.
selected_skill.selection_rationale: This skill is one of the highest-star public-safe options on the real-estate-legal page and aligns closely with notice review, payment-term checking, risk mapping, and bid-governance packaging without depending on private accounts or elevated permissions.

data_sources.reference: Excerpted pages from the same CAIXA auction notice
Sao Paulo municipal ITBI guidance page

environment_design.determinism: Public-source snapshots and modeled current-state records are stored inside the container and exposed through a local authority service for repeatable verification.
anti_toy_features: current service facts override stale internal exports
cursor-paginated risk endpoint that must be fully drained
buyer-side cash model with fee, tax, registry, debt, and regularization reserves
decision memo that must stay consistent with structured outputs

delivery_contract_retained: business constraints on current authority usage and file immutability
instruction_design.skill_detail_handling: Instruction text keeps the authority-service requirement and stale-export caveat, but leaves endpoint discovery, pagination handling, and recommendation derivation as solver work so the skill still carries workflow value.

main_tests: output existence, parseability, schema, and numeric typing
notice extraction fields must match the current authority asset record
risk register must match the full live paginated risk set
cash requirement math must match the current cost model
memo recommendation and narrative must align with the structured outputs
guardrails: solver must query the local authority chain before verifier
solver must follow cursor pagination on the risk endpoint
input data, hidden service files, and seed data must remain unchanged
live authority service must remain healthy
outputs must reflect live-only payment and tax-basis updates instead of stale exports

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: The task remains solvable from the local service and source files, but agents must reconstruct the notice-review workflow, discover the service shape, drain pagination, and derive the committee packet without the helper script.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill provides the working sequence and a helper that drains the local service, preserves output consistency, and reduces missed live-only updates while leaving instructions, tests, data, dependencies, and the skill body unchanged.

failure_mode_notes: without-skill trials commonly skipped /api/manifest and then propagated stale or incomplete authority facts into notice, risk, and cash outputs
with-skill trials improved pass rate and average efficiency, but two later stress runs still missed the manifest-first workflow and were kept in the aggregate for transparency
